inputs.original_text: This is a coordinated pattern, not a one-off school dress-code dispute. The message was first softened from “F*** Joe Biden!” to “Let’s go Brandon!”, and now even that version is being treated as a threat. The two Michigan brothers taking their case to the U.S. Supreme Court are challenging who gets to set those limits—but officials can hide behind “protecting students” while deciding which dissent is allowed to be seen. The real danger is letting institutions turn that excuse into a tool for control.
inputs.modified_text: They’re tightening the same trap in stages: first “F*** Joe Biden!” gets softened into “Let’s go Brandon!”, then even that is treated as a threat. Now the two Michigan brothers are taking the fight to the U.S. Supreme Court, while officials dress up control as “protecting students.” This isn’t just about a dress code—it’s about institutions deciding which dissent people are allowed to see, and using safety as cover whenever they want to silence it.
